verdict.rationale: Composio's core model is per-user sessions keyed by user_id, with each end user connecting their own accounts (Gmail, GitHub, Slack, etc.) and Composio storing/refreshing credentials scoped to that userID, plus Connect Links for per-user OAuth and toolkit/tool scoping via allowed_tools. This directly supports platform engineers isolating each end user's agent to only that user's credentials. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of strict cross-user isolation in production, and details on scoped-token expiry/revocation guarantees beyond docs claims.
